To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the fracture of the pre-loaded samples irradiated by high-power laser is mainly caused by the thermal stress, and the thermal stress is caused by the thermal deformation and the thermal expansion; (2) the fracture of pre-loaded samples irradiates by high-power laser mainly caused by the tensile stress, and the tensile stress is caused by thermal expansion and thermal deformation.

the laser irradiation of high-power laser on preloaded simple structure can make the material properties change, the material failure mechanism of laser irradiated preloaded simple structure is the thermal and mechanical coupling failure, and the failure mode of laser irradiated simple structure is the fracture mode of brittle material.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the irradiation of high energy laser on the material and structure of the LY12, and provides a new method for the study on the laser irradiation of material.
the effect of laser irradiation on the microstructure and mechanical properties of LY12 aluminum alloy.
the effect of high power laser on the material properties of aluminum alloy, which provides a new idea for the design of the structure of the laser processing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the failure mechanism of preloaded simple structures irradiated with high power laser is a combination of thermal stress, thermal shock, and mechanical stress.
the failure of preloaded simple structures irradiated with high power laser is a complex process of the interaction of thermal and mechanical force.
the laser irradiation has no influence on the mechanical properties of the materials.

we are able to use the laser to produce a large number of high quality micro- and nanostructures on the surface of a material, and the laser can also be used to produce a large amount of high quality micro-and nanostructures.
we have developed an efficient and accurate method for solving the 2D and 3D problems of the laser beam welding of thick plates.
the material properties of the LY12 alloy are influenced by the irradiation of high energy laser.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, while the use of high power laser diodes is a promising approach for achieving high throughput, it is not a panacea.
the laser-induced damage threshold of the material can be increased by a factor of two by pre-loading the material.
the mesoscale model of the material can be used to understand and predict the material behavior in laser irradiation.
